hook.name: AvaxHookPoolsV1
hook.description: The AvaxHook hook for pools on tokens that already trade: the same fee and module logic as AvaxHookV2, plus an afterSwap check that reverts any swap the pool did not fill completely. Fees are beforeSwap/afterSwap return deltas: a 0.3% protocol fee, an optional creator fee of up to 10%, and cuts for up to 8 modules from an external registry, frozen per pool and capped at 25% per side, with an LP fee override capped at 30%. Exact-input swaps only. No proxy, no owner.
